name: one-studio
description: Guided motion-video pipeline with a writers-room (playbooks, script lint), continuous camera worlds, screen capture and sourced news: brief → script → storyboard → keyframe review → per-scene incremental render → TTS voice-over, offline music beds & SFX, caption choice → multi-ratio publish; a user library of looks, mockup kits and playbooks shared across projects; pronunciation dictionary and speech-to-text check for the voice-over; labelled draft previews outside the gates. HyperFrames for 2D/3D, Remotion for physics, anatomy explainers, lemo-opuscar characters.
